Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or comparable technologies. Experience supporting cloud migrations, production infrastructure, incident resolution, automation, and highly available technology environments. Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages. Strong understanding of networking concepts and technologies, including VNets, subnets, routing, VPN connectivity, load balancing, DNS, and network security controls. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019–2025, including server administration, configuration, patching, and maintenance. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
